sources.name: ClutchPoints, 25 Greatest Golfers of All Time (Nate Duffett)
NESN, Greatest Golfers of All Time (NESN Staff), 9 items
Elegant Resorts, Top 10 Best Golfers of All Time (Mark Martin)

changes_vs_current: Top 8 are the same eight names as before, but order shifts: Jones up to 3rd, Hogan 4th, Palmer drops from 3rd to 5th. Dropped Scottie Scheffler, Harry Vardon, Greg Norman (25th, just missed) and Brooks Koepka (none appear in any source I read). Added Kathy Whitworth and Nancy Lopez, plus Old Tom Morris (ClutchPoints lumps Old and Young Tom into one slot, so that entry is ambiguous). Snead/Player tie at 7.0 broken by current-list order.
confidence: low. No poll or large fan vote was readable: Golf Digest's Harris Poll page returned 403, Ranker returned 401. All 3 sources are single-writer or company lists, and two of them are short (9 and 10 names), so ranks 12-24 rest on a single source (ClutchPoints) and are essentially ClutchPoints' order. Only the top ~8 are corroborated by all 3. Cross-checks that were fetched but not averaged: topendsports reader poll (unscientific, closed 2025) had Nicklaus narrowly ahead of Woods; LINKS Magazine (~2014, split into American men, international men and women, so it cannot be merged) also puts Nicklaus, Woods, Jones, Snead, Hogan on top. Women and early-era players are underrepresented, so consider a manual check before shipping.
